ui.tip.chip_more: More presets, and your own .ini files from the presets folder
ui.tip.depth: Bits per channel: 10 removes banding in gradients (H.265, AV1, VP9, ProRes, PNG/TIFF)
ui.tip.estimate: Estimated size of one output file (rough: depends on the shader)
ui.tip.forced: Settings written as // key=value in the selected shader take priority over the window
status.playing: Playing the shader in real time (reloads when the file changes).
ui.tip.play: Play the shader in real time at preview size; the preview reloads when the shader file changes. Drag the slider to jump
ui.tip.codec: H.264: plays everywhere. H.265: smaller files. VP9, AV1: open formats (CPU only, slower). ProRes, DNxHR: editing formats (MOV, large files). Ignored for GIF, WebP and image sequences
ui.tip.preset: Encoding speed: slower = smaller file at equal quality
ui.tip.quality: Constant quality: 0 = lossless, 12 = nearly perfect, 18 = very good, 23 = good
ui.tip.container: File format: MP4 (universal), MOV, MKV or WebM (VP9/AV1 only); GIF and WebP (animated image); PNG, TIFF, EXR (numbered image sequence in a folder). Entries marked "not in this ffmpeg" need a fuller ffmpeg build
ui.tip.encoder: CPU: best quality. NVENC / AMF / QuickSync: much faster (falls back to CPU if unavailable)
ui.tip.bitrate: Fixed bitrate in kb/s instead of constant quality (0 = use the CRF)
ui.tip.color: Color space and range of the video
ui.tip.blur: Motion blur: average of several sub-frames per frame
ui.tip.loop: Shader period in seconds: the duration becomes a whole multiple for a perfect loop (0 = free)
ui.tip.audio: Sound file to mix in, aligned with the “Start” time
ui.tip.output: Output folder (empty = next to the shader file)
ui.tip.profile_save: Save the settings to a profile (.ini)
ui.tip.chip_draft: 720p, 30 fps, medium quality, fast encoding: for testing
ui.tip.chip_youtube: 1080p, 60 fps, H.264, very good quality: ready for YouTube
ui.tip.preview: Show a frame of the shader at this time  -  Ctrl+P
